params.body:
## Why

Asked for the Gentells links of a list of sources, Ask said there were none, asked whether to keep the pages, and after the yes showed the plan and asked again. Asked for a paragraph in between, it would not write before the second yes.

## What

- `source_links` says in its answer what can be kept and to show that plan at once with `source_keep`, without `confirm`. The person says yes once, to the plan. Because it is in the answer, it also reaches an assistant connected to gentells.com/mcp.
- A text the person asked for is written meanwhile with the publishers' own addresses.
- Ask's note names `source_find`: look there before saying a source is missing.

Nothing is kept without a yes to a shown plan, as before.

## Checked

- A real run on Ask's own note, tools and default model, throwaway database. Twelve links: the plan in the first answer, kept on one yes, a paragraph with the Gentells links after it. Fifty-one links: one yes, about 35 seconds per answer.
- The same run before the change asked twice.
- Full suite 1823 of 1823, `tsc` clean.

## After merge

Nothing to run.
params.title: Ask shows what it would keep together with the links, so there is one yes
